programme.title: Dogs with Extraordinary Jobs
programme.desc: Documentary about dogs that help humans in surprising ways, including a Great Dane that has helped a 13-year-old girl with a muscle-wasting condition to walk, swim and even ride a bike. Plus, the stories of a Border collie mix who finds survivors during earthquakes, a labrador-German Shepherd mix who helps stop ivory poaching, and a team of water rescue dogs in Italy.

programme.title: Dogs with Extraordinary Jobs
programme.desc: Looking at how a Sprocker spaniel's sense of smell and the protective instincts of an Anatolian shepherd dog are playing a vital role in the conservation of endangered species. Plus, a couple of canine colleagues who protect aircraft from potentially dangerous bird strikes during take-off and landing. Using their natural speed, stamina and desire to chase, the pair works at King Shaka Airport in Durban, South Africa, responding to emergency call-outs from air-traffic control.

programme.title: Big Cats: An Amazing Animal Family
programme.desc: Part one of two. Biologist Patrick Aryee explores how cats have evolved throughout the millennia, learning to thrive in inhospitable environments, as well as becoming the world's most popular pet. In the first edition there is spectacular footage of caracals jumping three metres to catch flying birds, and a rare Bornean bay cat, which was thought to have been extinct. Patrick finds out how tigers made the transition from South-east Asia's steamy jungles to the -40C temperatures of Siberia, and meets 'lion whisperer' Kevin Richardson.

programme.title: Big Cats: An Amazing Animal Family
programme.desc: Patrick Aryee concludes his two-part exploration of the feline family tree, revealing how the Canadian lynx learned to thrive in the snow and spread out, evolving and inhabiting new parts of the Americas. In Belize, he mounts an experiment that showcases the margay's supersharp senses and gravity-defying acrobatics, and heads to the training track with a cheetah to find out what speed it is capable of. Finally, Patrick tells the story of the cat's domestication in Essaouira, Morocco, believed to be one of the first places where one particular species first gave up life in the wild in return for food, warmth, security and a home.

programme.title: Micro Monsters with David Attenborough
programme.desc: David Attenborough employs the latest technologies to explore the violence, rivalries and deadly weaponry existing within the world of bugs. This first episode examines the survival tactics of its terrifying residents including killer ants, trap-setting spiders and beetles with the ability to shoot boiling chemicals at their enemies.

programme.title: Micro Monsters with David Attenborough
programme.desc: The broadcaster continues his bug-eyed view of the world of creepy-crawlies, revealing how predators defuse the defences of their prey. Highlights include the cockroach wasp, busy preparing a tasty - and very live - treat for its young, the whirligig beetle, which employs a water-based radar system, and the jumping portia spider, which feeds on other arachnids.

programme.title: Micro Monsters with David Attenborough
programme.desc: A further selection of creepy-crawly close-ups, focusing on courtship in the bug world. Highlights include scorpions shaking their booty, the perfume-wearing nasonia wasp and the tropical cricket, for whom romance goes out of the window as it uses bribery to seal the deal with would-be partners. One potential partner to steer well clear of, however, is the praying mantis, the female of which is notorious for eating the male just after - or even during - mating. Narrated by David Attenborough.

programme.title: Micro Monsters with David Attenborough
programme.desc: A close-up view of sex, bug-style, as David Attenborough talks viewers through the different ways in which creepy-crawlies reproduce. Size matters for the minuscule male orb spider, creepily sneaking up on its intended and trying to mate without her noticing, while there's no rest for the lothario-like butterfly, which has plenty of notches on its proverbial bedpost. However, the harvestman spider has no use for sex at all, and reproduces by cloning itself.

programme.title: Micro Monsters with David Attenborough
programme.desc: David Attenborough shifts the focus to bugs that prefer co-operation rather than conflict. They include burrowing cockroaches, the suitably named social spiders - which share a 30-metre web - the queen bee and her happy hive of workers and green ants pulling together to build a nest.

programme.title: Micro Monsters with David Attenborough
programme.desc: The broadcaster concludes his close-up examination of the creepy-crawly world, shifting focus to the bugs' ultimate invention - the colony. Key residents of these minuscule mega-cities include honey bees, termites, leafcutter ants - who have a knack for farming - and their Argentine cousins, members of a community so vast it spans an entire continent.

programme.title: Deadly Australians
programme.desc: As water flows from Australia's highlands into the seas, environmental changes set the stage for unexpected clashes between predators and their prey.

programme.title: Shark Squad
programme.desc: Leading shark ecologist Mauricio Hoyos attempts a TV first as he attaches a camera to the dorsal fin of a great white shark off Guadalupe Island.

programme.title: Wild Philippines

programme.desc: A look at the life and career of the Scottish actor, who rose to fame as the original screen James Bond and won an Oscar for his role in The Untouchables.

programme.title: The Directors
programme.desc: The life and work of English film-maker Carol Reed, who directed movies including The Third Man, Odd Man Out and Our Man in Havana, and won an Oscar for 1968 musical Oliver!

programme.title: Rise of the Superheroes
programme.desc: A look at how the tales of comic book superheroes like Batman and the Avengers were adapted for cinema before going on to dominate Hollywood and captivate audiences worldwide.

programme.title: Jackie Stewart
programme.desc: Documentary about Formula 1 great Jackie Stewart, from his humble beginnings outside Glasgow to winning three World Drivers' Championships.

programme.title: I Am Paul Walker
programme.desc: Documentary exploring the life and legacy of American actor Paul Walker, who rose to fame in the Fast and Furious franchise, but died at the age of 40 after a car crash.

programme.title: Be Water
programme.desc: A look at Bruce Lee's time in Hong Kong making four films, exploring questions of identity and representation through rare archive, intimate interviews, and Lee's writings.

programme.title: Bruno v Tyson
programme.desc: The story of the boxing rivalry between Frank Bruno and Mike Tyson, spanning two epic fights marred by politics and volatile race relations, with the old foes coming together for a reunion.

programme.title: My Icon: Duke McKenzie
programme.desc: The former world champion boxer talks about the individuals that have been an inspiration to him over the course of his career.

programme.title: Rik Mayall: Magnificent B'stard
programme.desc: A documentary tribute to the influential and much-missed comedian, a man driven by punk spirit and an unrelenting commitment to pushing boundaries. When he died in 2014 at the age of 56, Rik left behind a body of ground-breaking work, from Rick the Poet and Kevin Turvey to The Young Ones, Bottom and The New Statesman - performances that redefined television comedy and helped ignite the alternative comedy revolution. The film explores his comedic journey, his creative partnership with Adrian Edmondson, his struggle with drink and the near-fatal quad-bike accident that left him fighting not only for his life but also his future. Contributors include Stephen Fry, Ben Elton, Greg Davies, Paul Jackson, John Lloyd, Nigel Planer and Adrian Edmondson.

programme.title: God Bless Ozzy Osbourne
programme.desc: A profile of Black Sabbath member Ozzy Osbourne, from the wild and hedonistic days that adversely affected his personal life, through the years of depression, alcoholism and drug dependency that followed. The programme also reveals how he overcame his demons, with the help of his second wife Sharon. Featuring interviews with Paul McCartney, Motley Crue drummer Tommy Lee and others.

programme.title: Tina
programme.desc: Born Anna Mae Bullock in 1939, Tina Turner has sold in excess of 100 million records and earned numerous plaudits including Grammy awards and induction into the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame with her first husband, Ike Turner. She was the first woman to grace the cover of Rolling Stone magazine and dabbled in acting including a memorable performance opposite Mel Gibson in Mad Max Beyond Thunderdome. Following a prolonged period of ill health, Turner intends to retire from the spotlight with her second husband, Erwin Bach. She bids farewell to her fans in the emotional documentary Tina. Directed by Dan Lindsay and TJ Martin, the film invites the singer to reminisce about her turbulent life and career with glowing contributions from friends, family and fans including Oprah Winfrey and Angela Bassett.

programme.title: Jason Bourne
programme.desc: Former government operative Jason Bourne has been in hiding for 12 years after exposing a sinister CIA operation. However, he once again finds himself being hunted down when a former CIA operative gone rogue acquires top secret information - including details of Bourne's own father's involvement in a clandestine scheme. Action thriller, starring Matt Damon, Tommy Lee Jones, Alicia Vikander and Julia Stiles.

programme.title: The Bourne Identity
programme.desc: A fishing boat crew plucks a man out of the sea with two bullet wounds in his back and a safety-deposit number sewn into his skin - but absolutely no memory of who he is or how he got there. In the search for his true identity, he is pursued by assassins - but his skill at evading them suggests his own past is far from straightforward. Thriller, starring Matt Damon, Franka Potente, Chris Cooper, Clive Owen and Brian Cox.

programme.title: The Bourne Supremacy
programme.desc: The amnesiac assassin is living quietly in hiding, until his former employers come after him again and murder his girlfriend. A CIA operation has ended in disaster, and those responsible intend to clear their names by implicating Bourne. As the former secret agent tries to evade the hitmen on his trail, he also struggles to piece together the truth about his past. Action thriller sequel, starring Matt Damon, Brian Cox, Joan Allen and Julia Stiles.

programme.title: The Bourne Ultimatum
programme.desc: Amnesiac rogue assassin Jason Bourne's long-buried memories are reawakened by a British journalist researching the secret organisation that was responsible for transforming him into a killing machine. Meanwhile, a ruthless CIA director becomes convinced Bourne is still a security risk, and plans to dispose of him once and for all. Third instalment of the spy thriller series, directed by Paul Greengrass and starring Matt Damon, Joan Allen, Julia Stiles, David Strathairn, Paddy Considine, Scott Glenn and Albert Finney.

programme.title: The Bourne Legacy
programme.desc: The leaders of a secret government agency plan to eliminate several agents as part of a cover-up when they face having their dark secrets exposed. One of the targets is able to evade his fate and go on the run - but his escape is threatened by his dependence on drugs to boost his physical and mental capabilities. Spy thriller sequel, with Jeremy Renner, Rachel Weisz and Edward Norton.

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: The masked avenger stalks the streets of Gotham City, waging a nightly war against the criminal element. However, he may have met his match when the city's crime syndicate is taken over by the crazed Joker, who plans to poison the populace with toxic chemicals. Tim Burton's comic-book adventure, starring Michael Keaton, Jack Nicholson and Kim Basinger.

programme.title: Batman Returns
programme.desc: The masked hero returns to face the Penguin, a grotesque crime boss dwelling in the sewers who conspires with a corrupt businessman to make himself mayor. When the tycoon tries to kill his secretary, she returns as vengeful vigilante Catwoman, who soon forms an intense relationship with the dark knight in both their costumed and real identities. Tim Burton's comic-book adventure sequel, starring Michael Keaton, Danny DeVito and Michelle Pfeiffer.

programme.title: Batman Forever
programme.desc: The masked crimefighter takes on the twin threats of disfigured maniac Two-Face and insane genius the Riddler, who are plotting to control the brains of the entire world. Meanwhile, an acrobat whose family has been murdered by Two-Face steps up to join Batman in his fight against evil. Superhero adventure sequel, starring Val Kilmer, Tommy Lee Jones, Nicole Kidman, Jim Carrey and Chris O'Donnell.

programme.title: Batman & Robin
programme.desc: The caped crusader and his sidekick take on the villainous Mr Freeze, who plans to destroy Gotham City with an icy doomsday weapon unless his demands are met. The dynamic duo also have to contend with femme fatale Poison Ivy, who is determined to drive a wedge between them. Comic-book adventure, starring George Clooney, Arnold Schwarzenegger, Uma Thurman and Chris O'Donnell.

programme.title: Erin Burnett OutFront
programme.desc: It's Erin Burnett's turn to step out front and try to maintain a viable viewer presence for CNN in the weekday news arena. But the former CNBC anchor won't worry about ratings for her hourlong general news program, comparing that burden to "death." Instead, she'll concern herself with translating world events into relevant information for viewers, paying close attention to such topics as the Middle East and women's issues. "I want people to say that our show is smart. I want our show to be authentic", Burnett says in a promo. "I want our show to have courage". Left unsaid, of course, is that she wants her show to have a big audience, too.

programme.title: Smerconish
programme.desc: After serving as an MSNBC contributor and guest-host on the network for four years, TV and radio personality Michael Smerconish believed he was ready to head a show of his own. CNN agreed, and thus was born `Smerconish', an hourlong Saturday morning program that takes after its host's independent views. Using a topical, conversational format, he aims for the TV show to be an extension of his weekday radio broadcast, with free-flowing topics and the ability to discuss issues that strike a chord with the audience. Along the same lines, he thinks it's important to present the content in an engaging manner, free of my-way-or-the-highway ideology. Smerconish, who has a law degree from the University of Pennsylvania, is also a New York Times' best-selling author.

programme.desc: Clark Griswold sets out to give his family a traditional Christmas. While his in-laws, among them a cousin from hell, sample his hospitality, they find themselves battling against rabid squirrels, and an exploding sewer to achieve a family Christmas that they will never forget.

programme.title: The Polar Express
programme.desc: A young boy who has grown sceptical of Santa Claus is shocked to see a train stop outside his window on Christmas Eve, destined for the North Pole. When he accepts an invitation from the conductor to climb on board, he embarks on a white-knuckle ride to Santa's headquarters, where he makes fast friends and learns an invaluable lesson about the true spirit of Christmas.

programme.title: Arthur Christmas
programme.desc: Everyone knows that, each Christmas, Santa Claus delivers presents to every last child on Earth. What everyone doesn't know is that Santa accomplishes the feat with a very high-tech operation beneath the North Pole. But when the unthinkable happens, and Santa misses one child out of hundreds of millions, someone has to save the day. It's up to Arthur, Santa's youngest son, to deliver a present to the forgotten tyke before Christmas morning dawns.

programme.title: The Grinch
programme.desc: The Grinch and his loyal dog, Max, live a solitary existence inside a cave on Mount Crumpet. His main source of aggravation comes during Christmastime when his neighbours in Whoville celebrate the holidays with a bang. When the Whos decide to make Christmas bigger and brighter, the disgruntled Grinch realises there is one way to gain peace and quiet. With help from Max, the green grump hatches a scheme to pose as Santa Claus, steal Christmas and silence the Whos' holiday cheer once and for all.

programme.title: Elf
programme.desc: Finding out that he's actually human, Buddy the elf leaves the North Pole to find his real dad in bustling New York, but when he gets there, his mean old dad doesn't want to know. While he's trying to convince his father, he gets a job as a department store elf, which he should be perfectly cut out for.

programme.title: The Polar Express
programme.desc: A young boy who has grown sceptical of Santa Claus is shocked to see a train stop outside his window on Christmas Eve, destined for the North Pole. When he accepts an invitation from the conductor to climb on board, he embarks on a white-knuckle ride to Santa's headquarters, where he makes fast friends and learns an invaluable lesson about the true spirit of Christmas.

programme.title: Dr. Seuss' How the Grinch Stole Christmas
programme.desc: Shunned by the relentlessly happy citizens of Whoville, the Grinch retreats to his gloomy lair on Mt Crumpit. Come December, the only one smiling is the Grinch, who's stolen everyone's presents. However, a little girl sees some good in the furry grouch, so there may be a merry Christmas after all.

programme.title: Four Christmases
programme.desc: One happy couple; four dysfunctional, divorced parents who all insist on celebrating with their kids; a single, well-planned, happy day quickly spins out of control into the madcap whirlwind of Four Christmases.

programme.title: Elf
programme.desc: Finding out that he's actually human, Buddy the elf leaves the North Pole to find his real dad in bustling New York, but when he gets there, his mean old dad doesn't want to know. While he's trying to convince his father, he gets a job as a department store elf, which he should be perfectly cut out for.

programme.title: Last Christmas
programme.desc: Nothing seems to go right for a frustrated Londoner who works as an elf in a year-round Christmas shop. But things soon take a turn for the better when she develops a growing attraction to a charming suitor who seems too good to be true.

programme.title: Just Friends
programme.desc: An LA record producer returns to his New Jersey hometown ten years after being rejected by his high-school cheerleader crush. Having made the transformation from no-hope geek to Greek god womaniser and with his friend still single, he embarks on a second seduction strategy that does not always go to plan.

programme.title: Genie
programme.desc: As his life unravels around him just in time for Christmas, Bernard dusts off an antique jewellery box that happens to contain trapped genie Flora, who might just be able to help him.

programme.title: The Night Before Christmas in Wonderland
programme.desc: Father Christmas travels to Wonderland to help save Christmas after the Queen of Hearts had outlawed it.

programme.title: All I Want for Christmas
programme.desc: A girl presents a department-store Santa with an odd request: reunite her divorced parents before her mother remarries.

programme.title: A Boy Called Christmas
programme.desc: An ordinary young boy called Nikolas sets out on an adventure into the snowy north in search of his father who is on a quest to discover the fabled village of the elves, Elfhelm. Taking with him a headstrong reindeer called Blitzen and a loyal pet mouse, Nikolas soon meets his destiny.

programme.title: Nativity!
programme.desc: A primary school teacher, who was once a failed actor in a former career, is given the task of directing the school's Nativity play, which doesn't have a positive track record. Attitudes change, however, when it transpires that a Hollywood producer is coming to film the play.

programme.title: Gremlins
programme.desc: A gadget salesman is looking for a special gift for his son and finds one at a store in Chinatown. The shopkeeper is reluctant to sell him the 'mogwai' but sells it to him with the warning to never expose him to bright light, water, or to feed him after midnight. All of this happens and the result is a gang of gremlins that decide to tear up the town on Christmas Eve.

programme.title: The Polar Express
programme.desc: A young boy who has grown sceptical of Santa Claus is shocked to see a train stop outside his window on Christmas Eve, destined for the North Pole. When he accepts an invitation from the conductor to climb on board, he embarks on a white-knuckle ride to Santa's headquarters, where he makes fast friends and learns an invaluable lesson about the true spirit of Christmas.

programme.title: Planes, Trains and Automobiles
programme.desc: Fastidious businessman Neal Page and slobbish shower-curtain salesman Del Griffith are the reluctant odd couple trying to get home from New York to Chicago to be with their families at Thanksgiving. Their thwarted travel plans keep throwing them together.

programme.title: It's a Wonderful Life
programme.desc: George Bailey has so many problems he is thinking about ending it all - and it's Christmas! As the angels discuss George, we see his life in flashback. As George is about to jump from a bridge, he ends up rescuing his guardian angel, Clarence - who then shows George what his town would have looked like if it hadn't been for all his good deeds over the years.

programme.title: The Bourne Supremacy
programme.desc: Jason Bourne is living in India when he is framed by Russian agent Kirill for the theft of millions from the CIA. Kirill begins to pursue Bourne, intending to assassinate him, but while Bourne and his girlfriend, Marie, are on the run, a shot meant for him kills her instead. Vowing revenge, Bourne sets out to prove his innocence and bring the culprits to justice, but he has to evade CIA head Pamela Landry, who is convinced he is guilty.

programme.title: The Bourne Ultimatum
programme.desc: A former CIA assassin continues his quest to fill in memory gaps. When a 'Guardian' reporter stumbles onto his trail, the man spies his chance to blow the Blackbriar black-ops brigade wide open. With some very powerful people intent on keeping their skeletons buried, he is in more danger than ever before, as his former paymasters send a series of elite killers after their reformed ex-colleague.

programme.title: The Bourne Legacy
programme.desc: Agent Aaron Cross must use his genetically-enhanced skills to finish what Jason Bourne started in this action-packed hit that takes the Bourne series to explosive new levels.

programme.title: Jason Bourne
programme.desc: It's been ten years since Jason Bourne walked away from the agency that trained him to become a deadly weapon. Hoping to draw him out of the shadows, CIA director Robert Dewey assigns hacker and counterinsurgency expert Heather Lee to find him. Lee suspects that former operative Nicky Parsons is also looking for him. As she begins tracking the duo, Bourne finds himself back in action battling a sinister network that utilizes terror and technology to maintain unchecked power.

programme.title: The Bourne Identity
programme.desc: An amnesiac is rescued at sea by the crew of an Italian fishing boat. Nearly dead, he carries nothing but the bullets in his back and the bank account number embedded in his hip. Although completely without identity or background, he possesses an array of extraordinary talents in fighting, linguistics and self-defence that speak of a dangerous past.

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: In an attempt to avenge the violent death of his parents, Bruce Wayne fights to rid the city of crime and in particular, his nemesis the Joker. However, his defences come down when an attractive journalist tries to track down the truth behind sightings of a huge bat-like figure in the sky.

programme.title: Batman Returns
programme.desc: After Selina Kyle sees more than she should in her boss's office, she has an 'accident', falling from the top floor of the building to the street below. Awoken by the licking of cats, she is surprised to find herself still very much alive. She vows to take revenge on her boss and becomes a female avenger, defending women under attack and providing assistance to Batman's efforts to keep the streets of Gotham safe.

programme.title: Batman Forever
programme.desc: DA Harvey Dent and vengeful scientist The Riddler plan to take down Batman, as Dent wrongly believes that it is Batman's fault he was disfigured, and the scientist is angry with Bruce Wayne for rejecting his experiments. The Gotham City superhero is going to need his new partner, boy wonder Robin, but will he be able to cope with the distraction of sexy doctor Chase Meridian?

programme.title: Batman & Robin
programme.desc: Batman battles super-villain Mr Freeze and seductive eco-terrorist Poison Ivy. With Freeze planning a permanent winter, faithful butler Alfred falling to a mysterious illness, and Ivy coming between the caped crusader and Robin, teaming up with Batgirl is the crime-fighting duo's only chance of saving the day.

programme.title: Tootsie
programme.desc: An out-of-work actor dresses in drag for an audition, only to land the female lead in a TV soap. When he becomes the most popular character on the show, he feels compelled to carry the persona into his everyday life. While bringing him phenomenal success as an `actress', life as a woman also has its problems - especially when he falls for an actress with whom he works.

programme.title: Risky Business
programme.desc: A normally well-behaved teenager goes wild while his parents are out of town. In charge at his parents' smart house, the 17-year-old sees the chance to make a fast buck when the prostitute, on the run from a scary pimp, appears at his door. He takes her in, and, following his school's entrepreneurial teachings, lets her turn the house into a brothel.

programme.title: The Cinema List: Epic Storytelling
programme.desc: This week's edition of the Cinema List is all about epic storytelling. From The Shawshank Redemption to Dunkirk, witness unforgettable tales of hope, courage and survival.

programme.title: The 'Burbs
programme.desc: An overstressed husband becomes obsessed with finding out the secret of his mysterious new neighbours. Concocting a series of increasingly outlandish schemes to discover the truth about the weird sounds he hears coming from the basement next door, the man settles on the theory that the family are a front for a cannibalistic cult.

programme.title: Dad's Army
programme.desc: In 1940, with a German invasion looming, the defence of Walmington-on-Sea is in the hands of local bank manager Captain Mainwaring and a motley collection of volunteers. After a series of blunders, the Home Guard finally gets the glory they deserve.

programme.title: Smokey and the Bandit
programme.desc: Tongue-in-cheek tale about a high-speed car chase across America involving a sheriff and a bootlegger with crash stunts galore. All goes well for the Bandit as he drives from Texas to Georgia with a truckload of illicit beer until he stops to pick up a damsel in distress, who also happens to be the sheriff's daughter.

programme.title: Blazing Saddles
programme.desc: Bart, a black railroad worker is appointed sheriff of a town marked for destruction by Hedley Lamarr, a scheming politician. As Lamarr tries to drive out the town's residents, Bart decides to stand in his way.

programme.title: The Witches of Eastwick
programme.desc: Three frustrated female divorcees living in a quiet town wish for the perfect man to enter their lives. When a mysterious, rich and charming stranger buys a mansion in the community, it looks like their prayers have been answered - but the man they appear to have summoned seems more than a little devilish. Based on John Updike's novel.

programme.title: The 'Burbs
programme.desc: An overstressed husband becomes obsessed with finding out the secret of his mysterious new neighbours. Concocting a series of increasingly outlandish schemes to discover the truth about the weird sounds he hears coming from the basement next door, the man settles on the theory that the family are a front for a cannibalistic cult.

programme.title: Police Academy
programme.desc: A group of good-hearted but incompetent misfits enter the police academy, but the instructors there are not going to put up with their pranks.

programme.title: Police Academy 2: Their First Assignment
programme.desc: Mahoney and friends have graduated from the Police Academy and are issued with their first assignments. As before, their cheerfulness and devotion to duty outweighs any shortcomings, but are they ready to do battle with a band of graffiti daubing terrorists?

programme.title: Police Academy 3: Back in Training
programme.desc: Slapstick farce with the incompetent cops as they set about saving their beloved academy from closure. Cutbacks mean that only one of the two police training schools can stay open, so Commandant Lassard appeals to the motley crew of graduates to come and train new recruits. However, the rival academy intends to sabotage their plans by cutting their training time down to a minimum.

programme.title: The Man With Two Brains
programme.desc: Zany horror spoof about a brilliant brain surgeon who falls in love with a female brain stored in a jar. The brain is part of an impressive collection held by a colleague in Austria and, upon learning of his wife's infidelity, the surgeon allows himself to be charmed. Communicating telepathically with one of the specimens in the laboratory, he falls in love - but needs a body to put it in.

programme.title: So I Married an Axe Murderer
programme.desc: A lonely poet who's unlucky in love believes he's struck gold when he meets Harriet, an attractive, witty woman who owns a butcher's shop. They fall in love and marry, but a series of strange occurrences lead him to suspect that his new wife may be harbouring a dark and deadly secret.

programme.title: Gremlins 2: The New Batch
programme.desc: Six years after defeating the Gremlins, Billy and Kate have grown up and moved to New York. However, Billy stumbles across Gizmo in a genetics lab and when he gets wet, all hell breaks loose, and the stage is set for more deliciously bad taste humour.

programme.title: The Big Heat
programme.desc: An honest policeman is determined to bust police corruption and the stranglehold of the Mafia. At first, he innocently begins investigating the Mafia-related killing of a fellow officer, but things turn nasty when his wife is killed in a car bomb blast meant for him, his child is threatened with kidnapping and he loses his job.

programme.title: The Hunt for Red October
programme.desc: Soviet and American forces give chase when the captain of a Soviet nuclear submarine sets a course for the Maine coast.

programme.title: The Polar Express

When he accepts an invitation from the conductor to climb on board, he embarks on a white-knuckle ride to Santa's headquarters, where he makes fast friends and learns an invaluable lesson about the true spirit of Christmas.

programme.title: Arthur Christmas
programme.desc: Everyone knows that, each Christmas, Santa Claus delivers presents to every last child on Earth. What everyone doesn't know is that Santa accomplishes the feat with a very high-tech operation beneath the North Pole. But when the unthinkable happens, and Santa misses one child out of hundreds of millions, someone has to save the day. It's up to Arthur, Santa's youngest son, to deliver a present to the forgotten tyke before Christmas morning dawns.

programme.title: The Grinch
programme.desc: The Grinch and his loyal dog, Max, live a solitary existence inside a cave on Mount Crumpet. His main source of aggravation comes during Christmastime when his neighbours in Whoville celebrate the holidays with a bang. When the Whos decide to make Christmas bigger and brighter, the disgruntled Grinch realises there is one way to gain peace and quiet. With help from Max, the green grump hatches a scheme to pose as Santa Claus, steal Christmas and silence the Whos' holiday cheer once and for all.

programme.title: Elf
programme.desc: Finding out that he's actually human, Buddy the elf leaves the North Pole to find his real dad in bustling New York, but when he gets there, his mean old dad doesn't want to know. While he's trying to convince his father, he gets a job as a department store elf, which he should be perfectly cut out for.

programme.title: The Polar Express
programme.desc: A young boy who has grown sceptical of Santa Claus is shocked to see a train stop outside his window on Christmas Eve, destined for the North Pole. When he accepts an invitation from the conductor to climb on board, he embarks on a white-knuckle ride to Santa's headquarters, where he makes fast friends and learns an invaluable lesson about the true spirit of Christmas.

programme.title: Dr. Seuss' How the Grinch Stole Christmas
programme.desc: Shunned by the relentlessly happy citizens of Whoville, the Grinch retreats to his gloomy lair on Mt Crumpit. Come December, the only one smiling is the Grinch, who's stolen everyone's presents. However, a little girl sees some good in the furry grouch, so there may be a merry Christmas after all.

programme.title: Four Christmases
programme.desc: One happy couple; four dysfunctional, divorced parents who all insist on celebrating with their kids; a single, well-planned, happy day quickly spins out of control into the madcap whirlwind of Four Christmases.

programme.title: Elf
programme.desc: Finding out that he's actually human, Buddy the elf leaves the North Pole to find his real dad in bustling New York, but when he gets there, his mean old dad doesn't want to know. While he's trying to convince his father, he gets a job as a department store elf, which he should be perfectly cut out for.

programme.title: Last Christmas
programme.desc: Nothing seems to go right for a frustrated Londoner who works as an elf in a year-round Christmas shop. But things soon take a turn for the better when she develops a growing attraction to a charming suitor who seems too good to be true.

programme.title: Just Friends
programme.desc: An LA record producer returns to his New Jersey hometown ten years after being rejected by his high-school cheerleader crush. Having made the transformation from no-hope geek to Greek god womaniser and with his friend still single, he embarks on a second seduction strategy that does not always go to plan.

programme.title: Genie
programme.desc: As his life unravels around him just in time for Christmas, Bernard dusts off an antique jewellery box that happens to contain trapped genie Flora, who might just be able to help him.

programme.title: The Night Before Christmas in Wonderland
programme.desc: Father Christmas travels to Wonderland to help save Christmas after the Queen of Hearts had outlawed it.

programme.title: All I Want for Christmas
programme.desc: A girl presents a department-store Santa with an odd request: reunite her divorced parents before her mother remarries.

programme.title: A Boy Called Christmas
programme.desc: An ordinary young boy called Nikolas sets out on an adventure into the snowy north in search of his father who is on a quest to discover the fabled village of the elves, Elfhelm. Taking with him a headstrong reindeer called Blitzen and a loyal pet mouse, Nikolas soon meets his destiny.

programme.title: Nativity!
programme.desc: A primary school teacher, who was once a failed actor in a former career, is given the task of directing the school's Nativity play, which doesn't have a positive track record. Attitudes change, however, when it transpires that a Hollywood producer is coming to film the play.

programme.title: Gremlins
programme.desc: A gadget salesman is looking for a special gift for his son and finds one at a store in Chinatown. The shopkeeper is reluctant to sell him the 'mogwai' but sells it to him with the warning to never expose him to bright light, water, or to feed him after midnight. All of this happens and the result is a gang of gremlins that decide to tear up the town on Christmas Eve.

programme.title: The Polar Express
programme.desc: A young boy who has grown sceptical of Santa Claus is shocked to see a train stop outside his window on Christmas Eve, destined for the North Pole. When he accepts an invitation from the conductor to climb on board, he embarks on a white-knuckle ride to Santa's headquarters, where he makes fast friends and learns an invaluable lesson about the true spirit of Christmas.

programme.title: Planes, Trains and Automobiles
programme.desc: Fastidious businessman Neal Page and slobbish shower-curtain salesman Del Griffith are the reluctant odd couple trying to get home from New York to Chicago to be with their families at Thanksgiving. Their thwarted travel plans keep throwing them together.

programme.title: It's a Wonderful Life
programme.desc: George Bailey has so many problems he is thinking about ending it all - and it's Christmas! As the angels discuss George, we see his life in flashback. As George is about to jump from a bridge, he ends up rescuing his guardian angel, Clarence - who then shows George what his town would have looked like if it hadn't been for all his good deeds over the years.

programme.title: The Bourne Supremacy
programme.desc: Jason Bourne is living in India when he is framed by Russian agent Kirill for the theft of millions from the CIA. Kirill begins to pursue Bourne, intending to assassinate him, but while Bourne and his girlfriend, Marie, are on the run, a shot meant for him kills her instead. Vowing revenge, Bourne sets out to prove his innocence and bring the culprits to justice, but he has to evade CIA head Pamela Landry, who is convinced he is guilty.

programme.title: The Bourne Ultimatum
programme.desc: A former CIA assassin continues his quest to fill in memory gaps. When a 'Guardian' reporter stumbles onto his trail, the man spies his chance to blow the Blackbriar black-ops brigade wide open. With some very powerful people intent on keeping their skeletons buried, he is in more danger than ever before, as his former paymasters send a series of elite killers after their reformed ex-colleague.

programme.title: The Bourne Legacy
programme.desc: Agent Aaron Cross must use his genetically-enhanced skills to finish what Jason Bourne started in this action-packed hit that takes the Bourne series to explosive new levels.

programme.title: Jason Bourne
programme.desc: It's been ten years since Jason Bourne walked away from the agency that trained him to become a deadly weapon. Hoping to draw him out of the shadows, CIA director Robert Dewey assigns hacker and counterinsurgency expert Heather Lee to find him. Lee suspects that former operative Nicky Parsons is also looking for him. As she begins tracking the duo, Bourne finds himself back in action battling a sinister network that utilizes terror and technology to maintain unchecked power.

programme.title: The Bourne Identity
programme.desc: An amnesiac is rescued at sea by the crew of an Italian fishing boat. Nearly dead, he carries nothing but the bullets in his back and the bank account number embedded in his hip. Although completely without identity or background, he possesses an array of extraordinary talents in fighting, linguistics and self-defence that speak of a dangerous past.

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: In an attempt to avenge the violent death of his parents, Bruce Wayne fights to rid the city of crime and in particular, his nemesis the Joker. However, his defences come down when an attractive journalist tries to track down the truth behind sightings of a huge bat-like figure in the sky.

programme.title: Batman Returns
programme.desc: After Selina Kyle sees more than she should in her boss's office, she has an 'accident', falling from the top floor of the building to the street below. Awoken by the licking of cats, she is surprised to find herself still very much alive. She vows to take revenge on her boss and becomes a female avenger, defending women under attack and providing assistance to Batman's efforts to keep the streets of Gotham safe.

programme.title: Batman Forever
programme.desc: DA Harvey Dent and vengeful scientist The Riddler plan to take down Batman, as Dent wrongly believes that it is Batman's fault he was disfigured, and the scientist is angry with Bruce Wayne for rejecting his experiments. The Gotham City superhero is going to need his new partner, boy wonder Robin, but will he be able to cope with the distraction of sexy doctor Chase Meridian?

programme.title: Batman & Robin
programme.desc: Batman battles super-villain Mr Freeze and seductive eco-terrorist Poison Ivy. With Freeze planning a permanent winter, faithful butler Alfred falling to a mysterious illness, and Ivy coming between the caped crusader and Robin, teaming up with Batgirl is the crime-fighting duo's only chance of saving the day.

programme.title: Tootsie
programme.desc: An out-of-work actor dresses in drag for an audition, only to land the female lead in a TV soap. When he becomes the most popular character on the show, he feels compelled to carry the persona into his everyday life. While bringing him phenomenal success as an `actress', life as a woman also has its problems - especially when he falls for an actress with whom he works.

programme.title: Risky Business
programme.desc: A normally well-behaved teenager goes wild while his parents are out of town. In charge at his parents' smart house, the 17-year-old sees the chance to make a fast buck when the prostitute, on the run from a scary pimp, appears at his door. He takes her in, and, following his school's entrepreneurial teachings, lets her turn the house into a brothel.

programme.title: The Cinema List: Epic Storytelling
programme.desc: This week's edition of the Cinema List is all about epic storytelling. From The Shawshank Redemption to Dunkirk, witness unforgettable tales of hope, courage and survival.

programme.title: The 'Burbs
programme.desc: An overstressed husband becomes obsessed with finding out the secret of his mysterious new neighbours. Concocting a series of increasingly outlandish schemes to discover the truth about the weird sounds he hears coming from the basement next door, the man settles on the theory that the family are a front for a cannibalistic cult.

programme.title: Dad's Army
programme.desc: In 1940, with a German invasion looming, the defence of Walmington-on-Sea is in the hands of local bank manager Captain Mainwaring and a motley collection of volunteers. After a series of blunders, the Home Guard finally gets the glory they deserve.

programme.title: Smokey and the Bandit
programme.desc: Tongue-in-cheek tale about a high-speed car chase across America involving a sheriff and a bootlegger with crash stunts galore. All goes well for the Bandit as he drives from Texas to Georgia with a truckload of illicit beer until he stops to pick up a damsel in distress, who also happens to be the sheriff's daughter.

programme.title: Blazing Saddles
programme.desc: Bart, a black railroad worker is appointed sheriff of a town marked for destruction by Hedley Lamarr, a scheming politician. As Lamarr tries to drive out the town's residents, Bart decides to stand in his way.

programme.title: The Witches of Eastwick
programme.desc: Three frustrated female divorcees living in a quiet town wish for the perfect man to enter their lives. When a mysterious, rich and charming stranger buys a mansion in the community, it looks like their prayers have been answered - but the man they appear to have summoned seems more than a little devilish. Based on John Updike's novel.

programme.title: The 'Burbs
programme.desc: An overstressed husband becomes obsessed with finding out the secret of his mysterious new neighbours. Concocting a series of increasingly outlandish schemes to discover the truth about the weird sounds he hears coming from the basement next door, the man settles on the theory that the family are a front for a cannibalistic cult.

programme.title: Police Academy
programme.desc: A group of good-hearted but incompetent misfits enter the police academy, but the instructors there are not going to put up with their pranks.

programme.title: Police Academy 2: Their First Assignment
programme.desc: Mahoney and friends have graduated from the Police Academy and are issued with their first assignments. As before, their cheerfulness and devotion to duty outweighs any shortcomings, but are they ready to do battle with a band of graffiti daubing terrorists?

programme.title: Police Academy 3: Back in Training
programme.desc: Slapstick farce with the incompetent cops as they set about saving their beloved academy from closure. Cutbacks mean that only one of the two police training schools can stay open, so Commandant Lassard appeals to the motley crew of graduates to come and train new recruits. However, the rival academy intends to sabotage their plans by cutting their training time down to a minimum.

programme.title: The Man With Two Brains
programme.desc: Zany horror spoof about a brilliant brain surgeon who falls in love with a female brain stored in a jar. The brain is part of an impressive collection held by a colleague in Austria and, upon learning of his wife's infidelity, the surgeon allows himself to be charmed. Communicating telepathically with one of the specimens in the laboratory, he falls in love - but needs a body to put it in.

programme.title: So I Married an Axe Murderer
programme.desc: A lonely poet who's unlucky in love believes he's struck gold when he meets Harriet, an attractive, witty woman who owns a butcher's shop. They fall in love and marry, but a series of strange occurrences lead him to suspect that his new wife may be harbouring a dark and deadly secret.

programme.desc: In 1940, with a German invasion looming, the defence of Walmington-on-Sea is in the hands of local bank manager Captain Mainwaring and a motley collection of volunteers. After a series of blunders, the Home Guard finally gets the glory they deserve.

programme.title: Gremlins 2: The New Batch
programme.desc: Six years after defeating the Gremlins, Billy and Kate have grown up and moved to New York. However, Billy stumbles across Gizmo in a genetics lab and when he gets wet, all hell breaks loose, and the stage is set for more deliciously bad taste humour.

programme.title: The Big Heat
programme.desc: An honest policeman is determined to bust police corruption and the stranglehold of the Mafia. At first, he innocently begins investigating the Mafia-related killing of a fellow officer, but things turn nasty when his wife is killed in a car bomb blast meant for him, his child is threatened with kidnapping and he loses his job.

programme.title: The Hunt for Red October
programme.desc: Soviet and American forces give chase when the captain of a Soviet nuclear submarine sets a course for the Maine coast.

programme.title: Dog Day Afternoon
programme.desc: A desperate and crazed man, with the help of an accomplice, takes a local Brooklyn bank hostage with plans to rob it in order to pay for his lover's sex-change operation.

programme.desc: Family and friends of the iconic Hollywood actor come together to share memories of his life and fruitful career.

programme.title: My Icon
programme.desc: Former football star Kelly Smith looks at the personalities that inspired her illustrious career.

programme.title: Queen of Speed
programme.desc: Michèle Mouton defied the odds as she broke her way into the world of motorsport when rallying was at its fastest and most dangerous. In doing so, she made history as the first and only woman to win rounds of the FIA World Rally Championship.

programme.title: The Directors
programme.desc: Explore the life of highly influential director Sergio Leone, credited as the inventor of the Italian Western genre, whose films include 'Once Upon a Time In America' and the 'Dollars Trilogy'.

programme.title: Discovering Film
programme.desc: A look at the life of legendary two-time Academy Award winner Robert De Niro, whose varied roles have included acclaimed performances in 'The Godfather Part II', 'Taxi Driver', and 'Goodfellas'.

programme.title: How The Beatles Changed the World
programme.desc: The fascinating story of the cultural, social, spiritual and musical revolution ignited by the Beatles.

programme.title: Boyzone: One For the Road
programme.desc: Against the backdrop of decades of personal history and the pressure of thousands of expectant fans, follow the band behind the scenes as they prepare for two landmark final reunion gigs at London's Emirates Stadium.

programme.title: Boyzone: the Final Concert
programme.desc: Go behind the scenes with Boyzone as Ronan, Keith, Mikey and Shane prepare for their emotional final concert at London's Emirates Stadium.

programme.title: Fatboy Slim: Right Here, Right Now
programme.desc: In 2002, DJ Fatboy Slim organised a rave event called The Big Beach Boutique 2 that ended up causing a stir. Instead of the 40,000 expected, over 250,000 ravers turned up at Brighton Beach, making history for good and bad.

programme.title: Hitsville: The Making of Motown
programme.desc: A look at the birth of Motown in Detroit in 1958 until its relocation to Los Angeles in the early 1970s. Featuring rare performances, interviews and behind-the-scenes footage offer insight into the history and cultural impact of Motown Records.

programme.title: Nick Cave's Veiled World
programme.desc: Examines the creative work and enduring influence of Nick Cave through the eyes of some of his collaborators over the years, including Bella Freud, Florence Welch, Colin Greenwood and Wim Wenders.

programme.title: The Directors
programme.desc: Explore the life of highly influential director Sergio Leone, credited as the inventor of the Italian Western genre, whose films include 'Once Upon a Time In America' and the 'Dollars Trilogy'.

programme.title: Discovering Film
programme.desc: A look at the life of legendary two-time Academy Award winner Robert De Niro, whose varied roles have included acclaimed performances in 'The Godfather Part II', 'Taxi Driver', and 'Goodfellas'.

programme.title: Discovering Film
programme.desc: A glimpse into the life and career of Jeff Bridges, who scooped an Academy Award for his performance in 'Crazy Heart' and also starred in 'Tron', 'The Big Lebowski', and 'True Grit'.

programme.title: Discovering Film
programme.desc: A look at the life and career of Academy Award-winning actor Sean Connery, who made a name for himself as the original James Bond alongside roles in 'Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade', 'The Rock', and 'Entrapment'.

programme.title: The Directors
programme.desc: A closer look at the life and career of Academy Award-winning British director Carol Reed, who is behind acclaimed films, such as 'Odd Man Out', 'Oliver!' and 'The Fallen Idol'.

programme.title: Rise of the Superheroes
programme.desc: Exploring how superhero films like 'Batman', 'Blade', and 'Captain America' took over Hollywood and conquered the world with larger-than-life characters brought to life from the pages of comic books.

programme.title: Stewart
programme.desc: Powerfully emotive film telling the story of Formula 1 legend Sir Jackie Stewart, transcending the sport and exploring themes of love, loss and human vulnerability. Distressing scenes.

programme.title: I Am Paul Walker
programme.desc: Blonde and blue-eyed Paul Walker brought California surfer looks and warm charm to the characters he played. Ironically, the Glendale native known for co-starring in 'The Fast and the Furious' movies was in a vehicle when he lost his life.

programme.title: Bruce Lee: Be Water
programme.desc: Charting the struggles of Bruce Lee in two worlds after he returned to Hong Kong to complete four films following Hollywood rejection, exploring questions of identity and representation through rare archives, intimate interviews, and his writings.

programme.title: Bruno v Tyson
programme.desc: Legendary boxers Frank Bruno and Mike Tyson reunite to talk about their relationship and epic rivalry shaped by two heavyweight title fights marred by politics and volatile race relations.

programme.title: My Icon
programme.desc: Former world champion boxer Duke McKenzie talks about the individuals that have been an inspiration to him over the course of his career.

programme.title: Rik Mayall: Magnificent B'Stard
programme.desc: Explores the life, career, and legacy of the iconic British comedian Rik Mayall. Drawing on previously unseen family archives and unheard audio, the film traces his journey from punk-spirited alternative comedy to his most iconic characters.

programme.title: God Bless Ozzy Osbourne
programme.desc: A portrait of rocker Ozzy Osbourne, including his time as lead singer of Black Sabbath, his solo career and his struggles with substance abuse.

programme.title: Tina
programme.desc: A revealing and intimate look at the life and career of musical icon Tina Turner, charting her improbable rise to early fame, her personal and professional struggles throughout her life and her resurgence as a global phenomenon in the 1980s.

programme.title: Jealous Guy: The Assassination of John Lennon
programme.desc: Seen through the eyes of the journalist Jack Jones, an exploration of the life and career of the Beatles superstar, with a look at the strange parallels between Lennon and his killer, Mark David Chapman.

programme.title: Terry Venables: A Man Can Dream
programme.desc: A look at the extraordinary life and times of Terry Venables, intertwined with the story of England's unforgettable run at Euro 96, with insight from players, friends, and family.

programme.title: The Directors
programme.desc: A look at the life and career of the award-winning director behind movies such as 'The Manchurian Candidate, Birdman of Alcatraz, The Train and Ronin' - John Frankenheimer.

programme.title: Discovering Film
programme.desc: A look at the life and career of Academy Award-winning actor Robin Williams, who became known for his much-loved films such as 'Jumanji', 'Mrs Doubtfire', 'Good Will Hunting', and 'Dead Poets Society'.

programme.title: Discovering Film
programme.desc: A look at the life of legendary two-time Academy Award winner Robert De Niro, whose varied roles have included acclaimed performances in 'The Godfather Part II', 'Taxi Driver', and 'Goodfellas'.

programme.desc: Explore the life of highly influential director Sergio Leone, credited as the inventor of the Italian Western genre, whose films include 'Once Upon a Time In America' and the 'Dollars Trilogy'.

programme.title: Lancaster
programme.desc: Archival material, first-hand accounts, and extraordinary aerial footage tell the story of the Avro Lancaster, the iconic British bomber at the heart of some of the most daring missions flown during the Second World War.

programme.title: Spitfire
programme.desc: In commemoration of the Royal Air Force's centenary, an exploration of the fascinating history of the Supermarine Spitfire and the fighter pilots who helped win the Battle of Britain during the Second World War.

programme.title: The Commandant's Shadow
programme.desc: Hans Jürgen Höss, the 87-year-old son of Rudolf Höss, faces his father's terrible legacy as he meets Auschwitz survivor Anita Lasker-Wallfisch. Hans enjoyed a happy childhood while Anita was trying to survive the concentration camp.

programme.title: My Icon

programme.desc: A nostalgic look back at the first-ever moon landing, using extensive archival footage from NASA and rarely-seen videos.

programme.title: My Icon
programme.desc: Former Bradford Bulls and St Helens star Leon Pryce discusses the individuals that have inspired him in his life and career.

programme.title: My Mom Jayne
programme.desc: Mariska Hargitay's journey to understand and embrace the public and private legacy of her mother, Hollywood icon Jayne Mansfield.

programme.title: Gary
programme.desc: Following the extraordinary story of Gary Coleman's rise to international fame as the child star of `Diff'rent Strokes', his struggles with fame, and the controversy surrounding his tragic death at the age of 42. An insight into Coleman's private world through exclusive interviews with his fellow actors, industry insiders and his estranged ex-wife and parents.

programme.title: Tagesschau
programme.desc:
Seit 1952 wird die Nachrichtensendung präsentiert. Sie informiert täglich über die wichtigsten Ereignisse aus Politik, Wirtschaft, Gesellschaft, Kultur und Sport. Die Sendung bietet einen kompakten und verlässlichen Überblick über das nationale und internationale Geschehen.

Reporterinnen und Reporter sowie Korrespondentinnen und Korrespondenten berichten aus dem In- und Ausland und ordnen aktuelle Entwicklungen verständlich und fundiert ein. programme.title: Der Hafenpastor

programme.title: Morden im Norden
programme.desc:
In der Lübecker Justizvollzugsanstalt wird ein Häftling im Duschraum tot aufgefunden. Er wurde zusammengeschlagen und dabei tödlich am Kopf verletzt.

Der Mann saß wegen einer besonders feigen Tat im Gefängnis: Er hatte eine Frau die Treppe einer Unterführung hinuntergestoßen. War das der Grund für seinen Tod?

Der Verdacht fällt auf den Gewaltverbrecher Arndt Jaschke, der sich in der JVA schon mehrere Schlägereien mit dem Opfer geliefert hatte. Aber die Spurenanalyse entlastet Jaschke.

War es sein Zellennachbar, der freundliche junge Jan Gremberg, der wegen einer Geringfügigkeit einsitzt? Und was versucht Jaschkes Anwalt zu verbergen?

Als die Ermittler herausfinden, dass es außerhalb des Gefängnisses Verbindungen zwischen allen Beteiligten gibt, erscheint der Fall plötzlich in einem ganz anderen Licht. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Rote Rosen
programme.desc:
Franka versucht, Mo und Julius davon zu überzeugen, sich noch eine Chance als Paar zu geben. Doch beide geben vor, nichts als Freundschaft voneinander zu wollen. Erst ein Traum lässt Mo erkennen, dass er noch immer Gefühle für Julius hat. Als er ihm das gestehen will, glaubt er, Julius habe sich wieder Richard zugewandt ...

Lou erträgt die Vorstellung nicht, dass Richard nach Kuala Lumpur geht und nicht mehr Teil ihres Lebens ist. Sie bittet Richard, mit nach München zu ziehen. Doch kaum hat er zugesagt, taucht Victoria auf und macht ihm ein Angebot, das seine Pläne völlig über den Haufen wirft.

Michael erfährt von Britta, dass er möglicherweise eine tödliche Erbkrankheit hat. Überstürzt bucht er einen Flug nach New York zu einer Spezialistin, ohne seiner Familie über die Diagnose zu informieren. Mit einer romantischen Geste nimmt er Abschied von der ahnungslosen Carla.

Toni sucht nach einer sinnvollen Aufgabe und bietet Britta an, die Pflegestrukturen im Krankenhaus zu reformieren. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Sturm der Liebe
programme.desc:
Larissa hilft Adam, der nicht ahnt, dass sie einen perfiden Plan verfolgt. Massimo muss erkennen, dass Adam ihm zuvorgekommen ist. Emilia ist enttäuscht, als Erik ihr den DJ-Gig wieder absagt.

Larissa bekommt mit, dass Werner Adam "Fürstenhof"-Anteile in Aussicht gestellt hat. Als sie erfährt, dass die Küche dringend einen neuen Küchenchef braucht, lässt sie zu Adams Gunsten ihre Kontakte spielen und vermittelt ihm den berühmten Sternekoch Fernando Oliveira. Obwohl sie sich Adam gegenüber selbstlos und großzügig gibt, verrät sie ihrem alten Freund Fernando ihren wahren Plan: Adam soll sich in sie verlieben, damit sie ihm später seine Anteile abnehmen kann.

Alexander eröffnet Massimo und Adam Werners Plan. Wenn die beiden sich in den kommenden Wochen als würdige Nachfolger erweisen, wird er ihnen seine Anteile überschreiben. Alexander soll darauf ein Auge haben. Massimo und Adam nehmen die Herausforderung an. Obwohl Massimo die Unterstützung seines Vaters Alexander hat, kommt Adam ihm mit einer Lösung für den neuen Küchenchef zuvor.

Emilia macht Olivia klar, dass Erik sie nie offiziell für die Club-Eröffnung engagiert hat. Da Erik jedoch kein "Nein" von Emilia akzeptieren möchte, stimmt Olivia ihrem einmaligen Auftritt als DJ zu. Emilia stürzt sich in die Vorbereitung und ist voller Vorfreude. Als Erik jedoch überraschend das Angebot eines bekannten DJs bekommt, sagt er der enttäuschten Emilia wieder ab. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Seelöwe & Co. – tierisch beliebt
programme.sub-title: Gorillas an der Bar und vorsichtige Giraffen
programme.desc:
Das Becken der Brillenpinguine bekommt eine Schönheitskur, Giraffen testen ein neues Geschicklichkeits-Spielzeug, Jägerlieste (Lachender Hans) üben für ihren großen Auftritt, bei den Gorillas öffnet wieder die „Teebar“, Rabengeier Nestor ist beim Training kitzlig und Tierpfleger Bene nimmt Abschied: Im Erlebnis-Zoo Hannover pulsiert das Leben wie immer tierisch!

**Zungenakrobatik**

Im Sambesi-Revier testen die Giraffen Jamila und Niobe eine neue Beschäftigung. Die hölzernen Futterbretter verlangen Geschicklichkeit, denn die Pellets müssen mit der bis zu 50 Zentimeter langen Zunge durch kleine Öffnungen herausgefischt werden.

Giraffen sind sehr vorsichtige Fluchttiere – alles Neue wird erst einmal misstrauisch beäugt. Mit viel Geduld lockt Tierpfleger Fabian seine Schützlinge näher heran. Wird Jamila den entscheidenden Versuch wagen? Oder bleibt sie lieber auf Sicherheitsabstand?

**Ein letzter Tauchgang**

Tierpfleger Bene darf an seinem letzten Arbeitstag noch einmal ins Becken steigen und die Scheiben für seine geliebten Brillenpinguine reinigen. Bene genießt den Moment: noch einmal mit seinen Schützlingen im Wasser.

Außerdem verabschiedet er sich auf einer Tour durch den Zoo von den Tieren. Währenddessen laufen heimliche Vorbereitungen für seinen Abschied.

**Übung mit der Jetbox**

Bei den Jägerliesten läuft das Training für die erste große Präsentation auf Hochtouren. Tierpflegerin Angela versucht, die vier Vögel an die Transportkiste zu gewöhnen, eine wichtige Voraussetzung für ihren späteren Auftritt im ARTrium.

Obwohl das Training Konzentration verlangt, bringen die „lachenden Hänse“ mit ihrem unverwechselbaren Gelächter viel Leben in die Voliere. Vorher müssen alle noch gewogen werden. Es geht kreuz und quer, die Vögel fliegen auf die Waage, wie sie lustig sind. Kann Angela noch den Überblick behalten?

**Neuer Glanz für die Teebar**

Im Reich der Gorillas wird der Termitenhügel gründlich repariert. Marvin und Ray arbeiten daran, gefährliche Kanten zu schließen und die Röhren so abzusichern, dass die neugierigen Menschenaffen sich nicht verletzen können.

Währenddessen bereiten Sarah und Patrick auf der Außenanlage ein großzügiges Frühstück mit dem beliebten Früchtetee vor, inklusive frischer Äste, die als „Trinkhalme“ dienen. Als die Gruppe schließlich herausgelassen wird, stürzen sich vor allem die Jungen Tara und Anandi auf den neu gemachten Hügel. Doch die erwachsenen Tiere scheinen zunächst nur Augen für ihre Mahlzeit zu haben …

**Unterricht für den großen Auftritt**

Im ARTrium bekommt Rabengeier Nestor eine behutsame Trainingseinheit, damit er bald sicher vor Publikum auftreten kann. Tierpflegerin Angela arbeitet Schritt für Schritt mit ihm, der Vogel soll sich immer besser mit der fremden Umgebung vertraut machen.

An diesem Tag zeigt sich der Rabengeier erstaunlich entspannt und meistert erste Aufgaben, obwohl der pieksige Boden unter seinen Füßen manchmal kitzelt ...

programme.title: Wer weiß denn sowas?
programme.desc:
Zwei Teamkapitäne stellen sich gemeinsam mit den Kandidaten der Quizshow den unglaublichen und überraschenden Fragen des Moderators Kai Pflaume.

Seit der ersten Sendung im Juli 2015 waren das die Quizmaster Elton und Bernhard Hoëcker. Im Oktober 2025 übergab Elton den Staffelstab an den Schauspieler Wotan Wilke Möhring, der seitdem im Team mit einem prominenten Studiogast gegen Bernhard Hoëckers Team antritt.

Es gilt, richtige Antworten auf skurrile und knifflige Fragen aus Wissenschaft, Tierwelt und dem täglichen Leben zu finden. Beide Teams spielen um Bares für ihre Unterstützer.

Zu Beginn des Wissensspiels müssen sich die Zuschauer im Studio entscheiden: Setzen sie sich auf die Seite von Superhirn Bernhard Hoëcker oder von „Kommissar“ Wotan Wilke Möhring?

Moderator Kai Pflaume sorgt für eine ausgeglichene Balance zwischen den Teamkapitänen, die zuweilen hoch emotional werden können. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: In aller Freundschaft – Die jungen Ärzte
programme.desc: Dr. Ben Ahlbeck und Assistenzärztin Sofia Galura versorgen den schwer verletzten Feuerwehrmann Sören Dahmen (Niklas Hummel) nach einem heftigen Autounfall. Doch als Ben die Ehefrau verständigen will, reagiert Sören panisch und abweisend. \n\nKurz darauf taucht Nathalie Dahmen in der Notaufnahme auf – und fällt aus allen Wolken, weil ihr Mann zu diesem Zeitpunkt eigentlich auf der Wache sein sollte...

programme.title: Wunschkind – Der Usedom-Krimi
programme.desc: Nathalie, die leibliche Mutter, hat ihr Leben endlich in den Griff bekommen und will das Sorgerecht zurück. Pflegemutter Anja ist seit Jahren für Greta da, sieht sie als ihre eigene Tochter. Juristin Karin unterstützt Nathalie, während ihr Neffe Rainer gemeinsam mit Kollegin Ellen bald schon in einem Mordfall ermittelt: Der Pflegevater wurde getötet. Die Situation spitzt sich immer mehr zu – und Karin gerät in ein moralisches Dilemma… \n\nDem Film sowie seinen Darstellerinnen gelingt es, ein komplexes Beziehungsgeflecht feinfühlig zu zeigen und beiden Seiten eine stimmige, berührende Perspektive zu geben. Ein leiser Krimi, fast mehr Drama, der aber gerade wegen dieses emotionalen Zwiespalts hoch spannend ist.

programme.title: Monitor
programme.desc:
**Trumps Oligarchie: Amerika als Beute?**

Während das tägliche Leben der Bürger immer teurer wird, nutzt Präsident Trump seine Macht, um sich selbst zu bereichern. Kritiker sprechen von einer Kleptokratie, in der politische Macht, familiäre Interessen und milliardenschwere Geschäfte Hand in Hand gehen.

Was bedeutet das Ergebnis der Midterms für die Milliardengeschäfte des Trump-Clans – und für ihre Zukunft?

**Geheimdienst-Pensionäre: Ex-Agenten außer Kontrolle**

Der Fall des inhaftierten Ex-BND-Chefs August Hanning hat das Zeug zu einer Spionage-Affäre. Doch er legte auch offen, was viele nicht sehen wollten: Top-Agenten können ihr Wissen im Ruhestand an private Akteure oder fremde Mächte verkaufen – ganz legal.

Gemeinsame Recherchen von MONITOR mit WDR, NDR und Süddeutscher Zeitung zeigen, dass Hanning dabei längst kein Einzelfall ist. Trotz jahrelanger Warnungen fehlen bis heute wirksame Kontrollmechanismen.

**Generation Wut: verlorene Jugend?**

Nach den Jugendprotesten in Deutschland zeigen Politiker Verständnis für jene Jugendlichen, die in zahlreichen Städten friedlich protestiert haben. Doch was folgt daraus, wenn der Alltag von Schülern und Studierenden durch Investitionsstau, Wohnungsnot, soziale Ungerechtigkeit und Unsicherheit geprägt ist?

Ihre Zustimmung zu den Parteien der sogenannten „Mitte“ nimmt dramatisch ab. Hat die Politik die Jugend schon verloren? (Senderinfo).

programme.desc: Dieter Nuhr seziert messerscharf politische Unzulänglichkeiten, thematische Abseitigkeiten und den verlässlichen Irrwitz des Alltags und lädt zu jeder Sendung diverse Gäste ein. \n\nSeit Januar 2011 moderiert Dieter Nuhr die Sendung. programme.title: Die Carolin Kebekus Show
programme.desc: Kein Zucker, kein Fernsehen, jeden Tag frisch kochen, niemals lügen und natürlich nur pädagogisch wertvolles Holzspielzeug: "Die Carolin Kebekus Show" zerstört all die Elternmythen über gute Erziehung! Carolin kennt das: Da kauft man sich jede Menge Kochbücher mit gesunden Gerichten – aber der Nachwuchs nimmt das Gemüse dann doch am liebsten in Form von Ketchup zu sich. Über diese und weitere gescheiterte Erziehungsvorsätze kann sich Carolin bestens mit ihrem Gast, Hazel Brugger, austauschen: Bei Hazels letztem Besuch haben die beiden noch eine Babyparty mit einem Publikum voller Schwangeren gefeiert. Jetzt gibt es einen Rückblick und einen Reality-Check: Was hat sich seit den Geburten verändert und von welchen Erziehungsvorsätzen haben sich die beiden inzwischen verabschiedet? Anschließend treten Hazel und Carolin in einem Battle gegeneinander an. Bei "Nur die Lüge zählt" darf ganz offiziell getäuscht und geschummelt werden: Ist der Koffer leer oder schwer? Ist das Essen süß oder salzig? Und läuft auf dem Kopfhörer Pumuckl oder ein Porno? Wer von den beiden kann die als Mutter gelernten "Lügen-Skills" besser anwenden? Die Antwort gibt es in der "Carolin Kebekus Show"! Die neue Staffel der "Carolin Kebekus Show" ist immer donnerstags um 19.30 Uhr in der ARD Mediathek und um 23:35 Uhr im Ersten zu sehen. Im WDR wird die Folge am Montag, 9. November, um 23.00 Uhr wiederholt. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Wunschkind – Der Usedom-Krimi
programme.desc: Nathalie, die leibliche Mutter, hat ihr Leben endlich in den Griff bekommen und will das Sorgerecht zurück. Pflegemutter Anja ist seit Jahren für Greta da, sieht sie als ihre eigene Tochter. Juristin Karin unterstützt Nathalie, während ihr Neffe Rainer gemeinsam mit Kollegin Ellen bald schon in einem Mordfall ermittelt: Der Pflegevater wurde getötet. Die Situation spitzt sich immer mehr zu – und Karin gerät in ein moralisches Dilemma… \n\nDem Film sowie seinen Darstellerinnen gelingt es, ein komplexes Beziehungsgeflecht feinfühlig zu zeigen und beiden Seiten eine stimmige, berührende Perspektive zu geben. Ein leiser Krimi, fast mehr Drama, der aber gerade wegen dieses emotionalen Zwiespalts hoch spannend ist.

programme.title: Mankells Wallander: Inkasso
programme.desc:
Eine Martial-Arts-Trainerin wurde von Einbrechern erschlagen. Unter Verdacht steht zuerst ihr Exfreund Fabian; der spielsüchtige Türsteher hat Schulden bei gefährlichen Leuten. Bei den weiteren Ermittlungen steht Jungpolizistin Isabell (Nina Zanjani) eine böse Überraschung bevor: Mit dem Kickboxer Patrik taucht ein Lover aus Jugendzeiten auf. 

Dass Patrik sie nun erneut bedrängt, ist lästig genug – schlimmer ist, dass er seinen noch durchgeknallteren Bruder Leo im Schlepptau hat. Und beide kennen ein Geheimnis, das Isabell den Job kosten könnte… 

Kommissar Wallander (Krister Henriksson) tritt in diesem Fall ein wenig in den Hintergrund. Dafür ist diese Episode reich an gebrochenen, verstörten, beunruhigenden Gestalten.

programme.title: Monitor
programme.desc: Trumps Oligarchie: Amerika als Beute?: Während das tägliche Leben der Bürger immer teurer wird, nutzt Präsident Trump seine Macht, um sich selbst zu bereichern. Kritiker sprechen von einer Kleptokratie, in der politische Macht, familiäre Interessen und milliardenschwere Geschäfte Hand in Hand gehen. Was bedeutet das Ergebnis der Midterms für die Milliardengeschäfte des Trump-Clans – und für ihre Zukunft? Geheimdienst-Pensionäre: Ex-Agenten außer Kontrolle: Der Fall des inhaftierten Ex-BND-Chefs August Hanning hat das Zeug zu einer Spionage-Affäre. Doch er legte auch offen, was viele nicht sehen wollten: Top-Agenten können ihr Wissen im Ruhestand an private Akteure oder fremde Mächte verkaufen – ganz legal. Gemeinsame Recherchen von MONITOR mit WDR, NDR und Süddeutscher Zeitung zeigen, dass Hanning dabei längst kein Einzelfall ist. Trotz jahrelanger Warnungen fehlen bis heute wirksame Kontrollmechanismen. Generation Wut: verlorene Jugend?: Nach den Jugendprotesten in Deutschland zeigen Politiker Verständnis für jene Jugendlichen, die in zahlreichen Städten friedlich protestiert haben. Doch was folgt daraus, wenn der Alltag von Schülern und Studierenden durch Investitionsstau, Wohnungsnot, soziale Ungerechtigkeit und Unsicherheit geprägt ist? Ihre Zustimmungen zu den Parteien der so genannten "Mitte" nimmt dramatisch ab. Hat die Politik die Jugend schon verloren? (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Watzmann ermittelt
programme.desc: Ein Zeuge behauptet, jemand wollte den dementen Bauern Josef Lahner in eine Schlucht stoßen. Josef lebt zusammen mit seiner Tochter Sophie und seinem Enkel Christian auf einem heruntergekommenen Hof. Ob wohl seine eigene Familie aus Verzweiflung hinter dem Anschlag steckt? Oder hat die wohlhabende Bauernfamilie Wieland, der Josef viel Geld schuldet, etwas damit zu tun? \n\nKommissar Beissl (Andreas Giebel) hat in Berchtesgaden alles im Griff – bis auf seinen neuen Partner Jerry Paulsen (Peter Marton).

programme.title: Morden im Norden
programme.desc: Kurz nach dem Verschwinden Celine Bergers gibt ihr Mann Entwarnung. Angeblich hat seine Frau ihn angerufen, was Finn und Lars bezweifeln. Denn die Ermittler haben mittlerweile herausgefunden, dass die Vermisste eine Affäre hatte ….

programme.title: Meister des Alltags
programme.desc: Werden Kupferpfannen in der Spülmaschine wieder strahlend schön? Gibt es neben der Wein-Königin zum Beispiel auch eine Marillen-Prinzessin? Und kauft man fermentierten Thunfisch, wenn man für ein Salatdressing Anchovis braucht? Diese und viele weitere spannende und kuriose Fragen rund um den ganz normalen Alltag gibt es im SWR-Wissensquiz! Moderator Florian Weber stellt in "Meister des Alltags" die Alltagstauglichkeit seiner prominenten Kandidaten auf die Probe. Kabarettist Christoph Sonntag und Schauspielerin Alice Hoffmann treten gegen Comedian Bodo Bach und Moderatorin Enie van de Meiklokjes an. Kreativität und Ideenreichtum sind gefragt beim Erraten der kniffligen Fragen aus dem täglichen Leben. Beide Teams spielen jeweils für Projekte der Kinderhilfsaktion Herzenssache – und die erspielte Summe des Siegerteams wird verdoppelt! Unterstützt wird heute die Kinder-Musik-Welt der Siegmund Kiener-Stiftung in Baden-Baden sowie das Projekt "Klangschalen-Therapie" in der Grundschule Am Ordensgut in Saarbrücken. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Wer weiß denn sowas?
programme.desc: Schauspieler und Musiker Wotan Wilke Möhring ist ab Staffel 12 neuer Teamkapitän bei "Wer weiß denn sowas?". Zusammen mit Bernhard Hoëcker stellt er sich den unglaublichen, amüsanten und überraschenden Fragen von Moderator Kai Pflaume. Superhirn Bernhard Hoëcker und Quizmaster Wotan Wilke Möhring spielen im Team mit jeweils einem prominenten Studiogast, denn es gilt, richtige Antworten auf skurrile und knifflige Fragen aus Wissenschaft, Tierwelt und dem täglichen Leben zu finden. (Erstsendung im Ersten: 09.12.2025) (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Rote Rosen
programme.desc: Flora kommt zu Henrys Taufe nach Lüneburg – ahnungslos, dass ihre Tochter Jasmin gemeinsam mit ihrem Onkel Daniel heimlich ihre Hochzeit plant. Doch Flora spürt, dass etwas im Busch ist ... Julius weigert sich, Lilly vorzeitig aus ihrem Hotelpraktikum zu entlassen. Er hat andere Probleme: Mo will nach einem leidenschaftlichen Kuss mit Julius in Ruhe reden. Doch sie können sich beide wieder nicht der Anziehung entziehen und werden dabei von Lilly heimlich beobachtet. Richard hat sich entschieden, mit Lou und Daniel nach München zu gehen. Victoria ist alles andere als begeistert, sie will ihren Sohn nicht gehen lassen. Sie fürchtet, ganz allein in Lüneburg zurückzubleiben. Mit Gunters Hilfe öffnet sie sich Richard und bittet ihn, bei ihr zu bleiben. Tonis Gefühle für Jonas werden immer stärker. Nachts schleicht sie sich von Ellie weg, um bei Jonas zu schlafen. Und auch Jonas fragt sich, ob er für Ellie und Toni das Gleiche empfindet. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Sturm der Liebe
programme.desc: Kann Massimo Emilia erklären, warum er sie damals im Stich gelassen hat? Larissas Plan, Adam um den Finger zu wickeln, trägt erste Früchte. Frida ist perplex, als sich Störenfried Sinan als Lales Cousin entpuppt. Emilia bekommt mit, dass sich ausgerechnet Massimo dafür eingesetzt hat, dass sie ein regelmäßiges DJ-Engagement im Club bekommt. Sie wirft Massimo vor, lediglich sein schlechtes Gewissen besänftigen zu wollen, weil er sie damals im Stich gelassen hat. Massimo möchte sich erklären. Aber will Emilia die Wahrheit wirklich wissen? Um Adam auch emotional an sich zu binden, gibt sich Larissa ihm gegenüber verletzt und macht sich rar. Denn Adam hat ihr bei der Abmahnung durch Christoph nicht den Rücken gestärkt. Sie lässt bei Adam durchblicken, dass es sie enttäuscht, dass er nur eine oberflächliche Beziehung mit ihr haben will. Adam stimmt dies nachdenklich. Frida gerät mit dem ihr unbekannten Sinan aneinander, der ihren Videodreh stört und sich über ihre Ambitionen als Influencerin lustig macht. Verunsichert, was die eigene Followerzahl angeht, sucht Frida Unterstützung bei Lale, die ihr prompt eine Kollaboration anbietet. Doch für den geplanten Fitnessdreh werden zwei Leute benötigt. Frida ahnt nicht, dass es sich bei ihrem Partner um Sinan handelt – Lales Cousin. (Senderinfo).
